name: flowboard
description: Local-first Flowboard with Google sign-in and explicit verified Firebase cloud copies

scripts.test:rules: npx --yes firebase-tools@15.25.1 emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-flowboard-rules "node --test tests/firestore-rules.test.mjs"
scripts.check: node --check state-core.js && node --check app.js && node --input-type=module --check < src/config.js && node --input-type=module --check < src/auth-ui.js && node --input-type=module --check < src/cloud-workspace-ui.js && node --input-type=module --check < src/invite-ui.js && node --input-type=module --check < src/members-ui.js && node --input-type=module --check < src/adapters/adapter-contract.js && node --input-type=module --check < src/adapters/local-workspace-adapter.js && node --input-type=module --check < src/adapters/firebase-workspace-adapter.js && node --input-type=module --check < src/adapters/firebase-cloud-workspace.js && node --input-type=module --check < src/cloud-sync-controller.js && node --input-type=module --check < src/main.js && node --check tests/firestore-rules.test.mjs && node scripts/validate-static.mjs && node scripts/validate-performance.mjs
scripts.validate: npm test && npm run check && npm run build
